A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PL-Stitch work and contain readable text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–D. The shorter v2 bibliography does not indicate missing appendix material.

before.justification: v1 reports original surgical phase recognition and cooking action segmentation experiments, component ablations, qualitative analyses, and appendix cross-validation results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments, including the benchmark results in Tables 1–2 and five-fold cross-validation results in Table 7.

M1.justification: The shared encoder, temporal PL ranking, spatio-temporal jigsaw, and iBOT-based masked modeling remain unchanged. Algorithm 1, the training objectives, and Appendix A retain the same procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions retain LEMON pretraining and the same AutoLaparo, Cholec80, M2CAI16, GTEA, and Breakfast evaluations. The newly cited Curve3D and SpatiaLQA works do not introduce evaluated datasets or tasks.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same baselines. Table 1 still includes Endo-FM, EndoViT, LemonFM, MAE, VideoMAEv2, DINO, iBOT, and T-CoRe; cooking, cross-validation, and temporal-objective comparisons also retain their comparator sets.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendices B–D retain the same evaluation procedures, metrics, model sizes, and training budgets, including k=20 nearest-neighbor evaluation and 30/100 pretraining epochs for surgical/cooking models.

E4.justification: The component, temporal-objective, frame-count, and loss-weight ablations are unchanged. Both appendices retain global progression analysis, t-SNE sensitivity, additional attention maps, and nearest-neighbor retrieval examples.

E5.justification: Table 7 retains five-fold cross-validation with mean and standard deviation. Figure 8 retains the mean progression curve and standard-deviation shading across 80 videos. No uncertainty-reporting practice or run-count information changes.

E6.justification: Numerical and qualitative results are retained throughout. For example, Table 1 reports Cholec80 k-NN accuracy of 81.7% versus iBOT's 70.3% in both versions; Table 2 retains Breakfast linear accuracy of 21.6% versus DINO's 15.9%.

T1.justification: The PL distribution, Luce choice assumption, likelihood objectives, and Appendix A loss derivations are unchanged. Citation renumbering does not alter the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same procedural-awareness motivation, claimed novelty of PL-based self-supervision, two proposed ranking objectives, and performance claims across five benchmarks.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and applicability qualifications remain unchanged, including objective complementarity, attention-based procedural understanding, and the explanation of ambiguous procedure boundaries in Appendix A.4. No substantive limitation is added or removed.

D1.justification: v2 adds an abstract statement and GitHub link announcing available code and models; v1 provides no equivalent access pointer. Implementation details remain unchanged. The PDFs establish new access information, not the repository's contents or functionality.

R1.justification: Section 2 removes discussion of video–narration alignment, procedural graphs, and text-guided step discovery, dropping six works cited as v1 [12,32,42,62,66,67]. It adds Curve3D and SpatiaLQA as v2 [44,57], broadening discussion to higher-dimensional reconstruction and logical dependencies. The central novelty positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: The abstract receives localized wording edits, including replacing object correlations with correspondences, and two related-work paragraphs are revised. Section order and the organization of the method, experiments, and appendices remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 3–4 are slightly resized and repositioned, with minor caption emphasis and surrounding text reflow. The bibliography also reflows. All eleven figures and seven tables remain, without new result displays or table restructuring.

improvement.justification: The new code/model pointer and smoother abstract improve usability, while Section 2 removes discussion of several related procedural-learning approaches, reducing research context. The scientific evidence remains unchanged. These benefits and drawbacks do not establish a reliable net direction, particularly because the supplied PDFs cannot establish the practical value of the linked resources.
